labels.zh: 部署 / 容器 / 基础设施

when.zh: 第一次体检、准备发布、接手陌生项目，或你不确定该从哪里看起。
when.en: Use this for a first health check, release readiness review, unfamiliar project handoff, or when you are not sure where to start.

reasons.zh: 已识别到 Markdown、YAML、Python、JSON 项目；全量审计会覆盖架构、安全、稳定性、测试、发布、文档等全部维度。
reasons.en: Detected a Markdown, YAML, Python, JSON project. A full audit covers architecture, security, stability, testing, release, documentation, and the other dimensions.

when.zh: 你最关心认证、权限、输入边界、密钥、依赖供应链或用户数据风险。
when.en: Use this when authentication, authorization, input boundaries, secrets, dependency supply chain, or user-data risk matter most.

reasons.zh: 项目存在安全、隐私、服务端、部署、数据或 CI 线索，适合优先检查攻击面和数据边界。
reasons.en: The project has security, privacy, backend, deployment, data, or CI signals, so attack surface and data boundaries deserve early attention.

when.zh: 你准备上线、交付、迁移环境，或担心 CI/CD、配置、回滚、健康检查和告警。
when.en: Use this before shipping, handoff, environment migration, or when CI/CD, config, rollback, health checks, and alerts are the concern.

reasons.zh: 项目包含 CI、容器、基础设施或部署清单，适合检查发布可靠性和运行期可控性。
reasons.en: The project has CI, container, infrastructure, or deployment evidence, so release reliability and runtime control are relevant.

when.zh: 你想先知道测试是否真的能兜住关键行为，尤其是仓库里测试线索较弱时。
when.en: Use this when you first want to know whether the tests protect critical behavior, especially when test signals look weak.

reasons.zh: 未识别到明显测试目录或测试文件，适合先评估风险最高的测试缺口。
reasons.en: No obvious test directories or test files were detected, so the highest-risk confidence gaps should be checked early.

when.zh: 你准备重构、交接、扩展功能，或想知道代码是否容易继续维护。
when.en: Use this before refactoring, handoff, feature expansion, or when you want to know whether the code is easy to keep changing.

reasons.zh: 该组合关注边界、复杂度、一致性、文档和注释有效性，适合作为工程健康度专项检查。
reasons.en: This combination checks boundaries, complexity, consistency, documentation, and comment usefulness as an engineering-health review.
